# nico_measured_boot_trusted_machine (Data Source)

Measured Boot Trusted Machine endpoints manage automatic measurement promotion approvals for Machines at a Site

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nico_measured_boot_trusted_machine" "example" {
  id = "resource-uuid"
}

output "measured_boot_trusted_machine_name" {
  value = data.nico_measured_boot_trusted_machine.example.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `site_id` (String) ID of the Site

### Read-Only

- `approval_id` (String) Unique approval ID.
- `approval_type` (String) Whether the approval is consumed once or persists for future reports.
- `comments` (String) Optional operator comments about the approval.
- `created` (String) Time when the approval was created, or null when Core did not return a timestamp.
- `machine_id` (String) Machine UUID, or `*` when the approval applies to all Machines.
- `pcr_registers` (String) Optional comma-separated PCR register selector.
